name: Copper bars
description: Polished metal raster bars sliding on sine paths, with specular highlights, additive halos and depth so they weave in front of one another. Anti-aliased, so the edges stay soft at any resolution.

metal.description: Strength of the specular highlight. 0 gives flat coloured bands; high values look chrome.

glow.description: Additive halo around each bar. This is most of what stops them looking pasted on.
